SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.reorder_point, COALESCE(s.total_on_hand, 0) AS total_on_hand
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand) AS total_on_hand
    FROM stock
    GROUP BY sku
) s ON s.sku = p.sku
WHERE COALESCE(s.total_on_hand, 0) < p.reorder_point
ORDER BY total_on_hand, p.sku

WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', day)::date AS month, SUM(units) AS total FROM sales_daily GROUP BY 1), lagged AS (SELECT month, total, LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_total FROM monthly) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lagged WHERE prev_total IS NOT NULL AND total > prev_total

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders po JOIN products p ON p.sku = po.sku WHERE po.status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND p.critical = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT day FROM sales_daily WHERE units > 0 GROUP BY day HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sku) > 10) AS days_with_many_skus

SELECT SUM(units) AS total_units_sold FROM sales_daily WHERE day <= DATE '2026-08-31'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock WHERE on_hand = 0

FROM stock s

WITH totals AS (
SELECT p.category,
SUM(CASE WHEN w.city ILIKE 'Monterrey' THEN s.on_hand ELSE 0 END) AS unidades_monterrey,
SUM(CASE WHEN w.city ILIKE 'Guadalajara' THEN s.on_hand ELSE 0 END) AS unidades_guadalajara
FROM stock s
JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE reorder_point > 20 AND critical = FALSE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_daily sd WHERE sd.sku = s.sku)

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', MIN(day))::date AS first_month,
        date_trunc('month', MAX(day))::date AS last_month
    FROM sales_daily
),
months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(first_month, last_month, interval '1 month')::date AS month_start
    FROM bounds
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        m.month_start,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS total_units
    FROM months m
    LEFT JOIN sales_daily s
        ON date_trunc('month', s.day)::date = m.month_start
    GROUP BY m.month_start
),
comparisons AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        total_units,
        LAG(total_units) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS previous_total
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS months_with_increased_sales
FROM comparisons
WHERE previous_total IS NOT NULL
  AND total_units > previous_total

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS month,
        SUM(units) AS total_units
    FROM sales_daily
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', day)
),
month_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        total_units,
        LAG(total_units) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_total_units
    FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS months_with_higher_sales
FROM month_comparison
WHERE previous_total_units IS NOT NULL
  AND total_units > previous_total_units

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_cost) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
